scope: forty atlas components; audit role crosswalk, not upstream role API

components.flow: Secondary follows B; primary keeps fixed accent gradient/casts and filters the whole button on hover. Quiet has no backdrop filter; danger uses semantic danger accent inherited from base CSS. No tint control on its white body.
components.fallback_and_nesting: CSS recipe fallback; fixed primary/danger paint remains outside generic fill replacement.

components.flow: Delegates to Button; quiet by default. Its icon is content inside the label slot, not a separate refractive role.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Same variant/fallback limits as Button.

components.flow: Fixed well and thumb alpha; shared filter/rim/lift; moving indicator receives measured geometry. Hover of unselected labels changes ink.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well/thumb substitutions; forced selection retains Highlight/HighlightText; indicator motion shortened.

components.flow: Native hidden checkbox owns state. White knob, fixed casts and selected accent bypass GlassLook. Press adds fixed translucent lens/filter.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Rest well resolves opaque; pressed hard-coded lens survives reduced transparency. Reduced motion removes active scale but keeps state position.

components.flow: Native range; exact value fill, fixed knob, fixed active lens. Main optical parts do not consume Look controls.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Well substitutes; active thumb alpha and pseudo-element transition are not in shared fallback overrides.

components.flow: Glass regular shell plus caller children; quiet buttons are locally quiet. Shell consumes all Look fields; no child ownership policy enforces quiet variants.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Glass runtime fallback for shell, CSS fallback separately for children.

components.flow: Glass regular nav shell; child buttons retain their own recipe and hover translation/scale.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Glass shell fallback; explicit motion off removes dock hover transform, OS reduced-motion path mainly shortens transitions.

components.flow: Fixed well/selection plate with shared filter/rim/lift; panel is content, not another automatic glass sheet.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque plate/well; fallback selected-button paint before indicator ready; forced selected ink/marker retained.

components.flow: DisclosureSurface portals a Glass frosted shell with copied provider tokens. Trigger is caller content; rows consume local hover fill without independent blur.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Glass shell fallback; portal cannot retain unrecorded CSS look inheritance.

components.flow: Transparent command row; hover uses Look opacity through fill-hover; destructive ink is semantic. No own lens/blur/cast/ring.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Hover fill substitutes; depends on containing menu for readable ground. Inherits whichever portal scope is actually emitted.

components.flow: Same portalled Glass frosted shell as Menu; content has dialog role and may contain independently painted children.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Glass fallback and recorded-token portal limitation; no automatic nesting cap.

components.flow: Inline wrapper and bubble, not a portal; sheet, rim/lift and heavy blur. All Look fields through shared body/ring/filter/lift.
components.fallback_and_nesting: CSS opaque sheet/no heavy blur; forced-color real edge; remains subject to ancestor clipping.

components.flow: Quiet IconButtons plus native seek range and time output; container is not a Glass surface. K paint is fixed; buttons receive B subset.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Combined quiet-button/range fallbacks; no automatic WebGL media surface.

components.flow: Neutral body uses opacity fill; control filter, lensing and ring. Tone variants keep fixed semantic fill/ink and an additional tone inset. No generic tint or shared cast.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Control blur disabled in reduced transparency; semantic fixed-alpha body bypasses fill substitution.

components.flow: Image or initials on fixed radial/accent body. Shared lensing/lift/ring respond; no backdrop blur, tint or opacity body control.
components.fallback_and_nesting: No normal blur to remove; forced mode removes ring. Intrinsic image is not transformed into a new material.

components.flow: Layout grouping only; child Avatars carry D recipe. Fixed canvas outline and overlap, hover lift; no new group shell.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Child fallback; reduced motion suppresses transition but can leave instantaneous hover offset.

components.flow: Surface tint/gradient, rim/bloom/lift/filter; optional interactive hover uses high lift and transform. Footer uses hairline, labels use semantic ink.
components.fallback_and_nesting: CSS opaque surface and removed background image; children remain independent paint consumers.

components.flow: No optical shell. Label/value/change are semantic type/tone; liquid adjusts tracking. No direct GlassLook field affects its own body.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Depends on host readability; no extra optical layer to fall back.

components.flow: Native progress with fixed well and accent gradient/glow; dimensions/value remain native. GlassLook does not tune the value gradient/glow.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Well substitution does not remove fixed optional fill glow; browser-specific pseudo-element declarations differ.

components.flow: Native meter receives well on host; platform internals and thresholds own the value presentation. No custom Look-driven fill recipe.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Well token fallback is not evidence of identical native meter appearance across engines.

components.flow: Fixed border ring, accent top, semantic status text. No Look-controlled blur/cast.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Base reduced-motion and explicit off slow rotation to 1.6s rather than remove it; this is its explicit status policy.

components.flow: Fixed well body and animated fixed-alpha shimmer; no Look controls on its own paint.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well; base reduced-motion/off removes shimmer animation.

components.flow: Fixed semantic translucent body and signal glow; shared rim/lift/control filter and conic edge. Dismiss action has semantic hover fill.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Shared blur stops; fixed tone body/glow does not become an opaque surface via fill replacement.

components.flow: Fixed accent-alpha body and flare; shared rim/lift/control filter/ring. Caller action can be another independent B recipe.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Shared blur stops; accent body/flare remain outside generic opaque-fill substitutions.

components.flow: Semantic links/current text and slash separators; no material shell. Hover changes ink.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Host must provide readable ground; no per-crumb optical effect or Look control.

components.flow: Well/filter group; fixed-alpha selected page body with rim/lift/ring. Unselected hover uses fill-hover and changes ink.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well/thumb and forced selected pair; ordinary text retains host dependency.

components.flow: Whole accordion gets surface recipe; sections use hairlines, header buttons/content stay plain. No separate blur per row.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque shared surface/image removal; existing expand glyph/content motion receives base fallback.

components.flow: Overlay helper portals tokens. Fixed scrim filter plus heavy shell; built-in trigger uses B; close uses fill/lensing/ring. Close ring lacks local positioning (F01).
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque sheet/heavy filter removal; scrim fixed blur survives transparency preference; portal record limitation.

components.flow: Same Overlay helper and close-ring defect, with edge-mounted geometry/slide animation. All Look fields reach sheet, not scrim.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Same sheet/scrim/portal limits as Dialog; reduced-motion removes entrance animation.

components.flow: Sheet/high lift/heavy filter; fixed success-mark glow; built-in restore uses B. Standalone Toast is inline; ToastProvider supplies optional portal viewport.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque sheet, removed image/heavy filter; fixed status glow remains. Provider portal copies recorded tokens only.

components.flow: Native checkbox plus visible well/check. Checked accent relief/glow is fixed; ordinary Look fields do not tune the mark.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well; forced checked system pair and unchecked glyph suppression; independent native focus outline.

components.flow: Native grouped radios with well and selected thick accent border. Selected cast is fixed; no per-role Look patch.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well and system/native behavior; source does not prove all forced-color radio outcomes.

components.flow: Custom well shell around native select, chevron; explicit colorScheme. Rest fixed, focus fill consumes opacity; OS popup is not glass recipe.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well; focus follows CSS; native popup requires platform check, not inferred optical coverage.

components.flow: Fixed well; focus opacity fill and focus shadow, semantic invalid halo/message. No independent blur or general tint.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well/fill substitutions; forced-color focus needs special review because ordinary outline is zero and visible cue is box-shadow.

components.flow: Same E focus/error chain as TextField, native resize and multiline content. No new blur across prose.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Same fallback limits as TextField; native resize internals are not Look-controlled.

components.flow: Capsule well, search glyph, native input and clear action. Focus fill consumes opacity; action hover may use control-hover.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well/focus fill; clear action semantics preserved; no glass filter in the field recipe.

components.flow: Shared well around step buttons and numeric value; focus-within fill/halo. No independent Button glass on its plain step buttons.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque well/focus fill; native constraints remain separate from optics.

components.flow: Ordered steps with native buttons, semantic current/completed accent disks and control-fill upcoming disks. No Look lens/blur/cast; upcoming disk fill can inherit opacity through control remapping.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Upcoming fill substitution; current/completed marks retain semantic/forced-system cues.

components.flow: B shell/filter/rim; pressed body switches to semantic accent and ink, independent of tint. Does not run Button pointer handler.
components.fallback_and_nesting: CSS fill fallback and forced selected pair; fixed press paint not generic tint.

components.flow: Fieldset well plus native file input, glyph and live result. Drag/focus uses fixed 12% accent body, not Look opacity.
components.fallback_and_nesting: Opaque rest well; fixed drag/focus alpha bypasses substitution. File behavior is separate from material.
